label: The Shifting Deep: The Lost Party
summary: A famous party went into the Deep and only their map came back. The guild pays double to find out what happened.
title: The Lost Party
description: The Gilded Spear, Greywatch's most famous party, went down a month ago. Yesterday their map came back up the shaft by itself, covered in fresh notes in a handwriting nobody recognizes. The guild is paying double for a party to follow it.

chapterOutlines.title: The Map That Came Back
chapterOutlines.outline: Study the map and assemble the rescue party.

chapterOutlines.title: The Drowned Floor
chapterOutlines.outline: Follow the notes through a flooded floor full of things that hunt by sound.

chapterOutlines.title: The Gilded Spear
chapterOutlines.outline: Find the lost party, and the truth about who wrote the notes.

scene.location: The guild hall in Greywatch, at the long table where the map is pinned down with daggers
scene.summary: The map twitches now and then, as if something is still writing on it. The guildmaster wants volunteers.

openThreads: Who is writing on the map?
Is anyone from the Gilded Spear still alive?

npcs.name: Guildmaster Maelis Orr
npcs.description: A retired raider with one hand, a silver hook and a reputation for never losing a party. She has just lost one.

npcs.name: Dorn Ashgrave
npcs.description: A huge half-orc with a door-sized shield, a soft voice and a notebook of pressed flowers from every floor of the Deep.
goals: Find a flower that only grows on the ninth floor

npcs.name: Kip
npcs.description: A kobold scout who maps the Deep in chalk, disarms traps with their tail and has opinions about every door.
goals: Draw the first full map of the Deep

items.name: The Gilded Spear's map
items.description: A map of the Deep that someone, or something, is still writing on.

items.name: Healing draught
items.description: A red potion in a corked vial. Restores a good deal of health.

items.name: Rope
items.description: Fifty feet of good guild rope.
